Name: maclo_addr
Comment: lower 4 bytes of the devices MAC address

Name: machi_mdio
Comment: upper 2 bytes of the devices MAC address, promiscuous flag, MDIO interface

Name: length
Comment: iDMA Number of bytes to move

Name: req_valid
Comment: iDMA request valid, handshake signal asserted by user for data movement request

Name: req_ready
Comment: iDMA request ready, handshake signal asserted by hw that indicates iDMA is ready to accept request

Name: rsp_ready
Comment: iDMA response ready, handshake signal asserted by user so that iDMA will start moving data

Name: rsp_valid
Comment: iDMA response valid, handshake signal asserted by hw so that iDMA has finished data moving

Name: rx_irq
Comment: ethernet starts receiving packets, packets arriving at phy interface
